glosses: pundit (as a derogative term for an expert)

examples.text: Il me faut un avocat sachant parler français.
examples.en: I need a lawyer who can speak French.
Do you know anyone who speaks French?

examples.text: Ne sachant que faire, j'ai appelé la police.
examples.en: Not knowing what to do, I telephoned the police.

examples.text: Ne sachant pas quoi faire, je n'ai rien fait.
examples.en: Not knowing what to do, I did nothing.

examples.text: Ne sachant que dire, je gardai le silence.
examples.en: Not knowing what to say, I kept silent.
